scope: Economy, Organizations, Learn, Social and Media
method: Source review only; 27 page components traced to routes, controllers and selected shared components/services. No DB queries, browser interactions, app edits, builds or tests performed by this lane. One live learning defect was reported by the parent audit and is explicitly attributed.
limits: Action-backed means implementation exists in source, not that a live-world happy path passed.
No constitutional policy change proposed; recommendations reorganize discovery and repair missing integration.
Media host and real content availability were not inspected.

surfaces.rationale: Use an action-first landing with Wallet and Market. Move finance telemetry behind context and make request reads bounded before demo.
surfaces.confidence: high for source implementation; runtime untested

overlaps.finding: Learn home offers both Guides and Journeys. Guides is another journey-link catalog, while lessons are separate graded checks and the shell supplies another help drawer.
overlaps.recommendation: One Learn entry with lessons, practical journeys and media; contextual help remains attached to tasks.

overlaps.finding: Market and Exchange both list marketplace_listings. Exchange also has distinct secondary share trading.
overlaps.recommendation: One market with clearly labeled Goods/services, Work, and Shares sections. Retain specialized detail pages.

overlaps.finding: Unified agreement register links resident rows to an entire second resident register; organization detail separately shows contracts.
overlaps.recommendation: One register and focused detail, sharing negotiation components without flattening consent rules.

overlaps.finding: Economy Home, Treasury, Units and Stipend repeat currency/public finance or stipend context across four doors.
overlaps.recommendation: Personal activity in Wallet/Market; public finance inside government context with currency/stipend tabs and lawful act links.

overlaps.finding: Organization detail, CGC detail, finance, co-determination, board elections and transfers share organization data but are exposed as separate destination concepts.
overlaps.recommendation: One organization workspace, contextual tabs and actions; retain legitimate CGC/board distinctions.

demo_gaps.finding: Economy Home synchronously walks the entire ledger hash chain and groups the full ledger on each request, plus whole-table counts.
demo_gaps.next_step: Precompute or incrementally verify in bounded resumable jobs; serve a timestamped snapshot. Do not exercise this route against a large world merely to inspect it.

demo_gaps.finding: CoDeterminationController loads every live board with seats before applying optional organization focus.
demo_gaps.next_step: Load focused board directly and paginate separately bounded observation listings.

demo_gaps.finding: Lesson page renders quiz and next-module links, but module.surface_id is never used for educational content; global LearnFlyout resolves the generic learn/lesson surface.
demo_gaps.next_step: Render educational content for the current module before the quiz and connect to a relevant real exercise.

demo_gaps.finding: Applying is implemented. LaborBoardService implements post/accept/decline, but no employer route/controller/UI calls were found; service callers found in app are the demo command and application handler.
demo_gaps.next_step: Add employer posting and applicant decision flows using existing services, then verify hire/countersign/worker representation end to end.

demo_gaps.finding: Market shows help requests, but app call-site search finds only demo command insertion and read controller; no request/respond/resolve UI path found.
demo_gaps.next_step: Complete the participant flow if included in demo; otherwise omit this section from promoted demo activities without deleting the records.

demo_gaps.finding: F-ORG-008 implements issue_shares, but org finance shows a cap table only; no controller/UI invocation found. Secondary offers can trade pre-existing holdings.
demo_gaps.next_step: Expose issuance to the permitted organization role, or choose an existing populated organization for a read/trade demo.

demo_gaps.finding: The video player deliberately renders a labeled placeholder when the optional base URL is absent. Runtime configuration is unverified.
demo_gaps.next_step: Verify one actual lesson in target conference languages, including caption/audio fallback.
demo_gaps.confidence: high for fallback code; unknown runtime
